_about: Flags from tools/ball_speed.py --contacts that Demetre accepted on purpose. The check still reports them, marked ACCEPTED, and only the others make it fail. Each entry: chapter, room (as ball_speed names it), pattern (a regular expression matched against the flag's text), optional min and max for the first number the pattern captures, why, and who approved it and when. Add an entry only with Demetre's approval.

accepted.pattern: ^flight at .* falls at ([0-9.]+) per frame squared
accepted.why: card 4's softer gravity: its hops float, kept on purpose

accepted.pattern: ^contact at 3\.95 s leaves faster than it arrived
accepted.why: the 3.95 s contact leaves faster than it arrives: kept on purpose, card 4 is approved

accepted.pattern: ^turn-round at 3\.95 s .* off a surface tilted only
accepted.why: the 3.95 s turn-round off the 22 degree surface: the same contact, kept on purpose

accepted.pattern: ^contact at 10\.57 s leaves faster than it arrived
accepted.why: the 10.57 s contact leaves faster than it arrives: kept on purpose, card 4 is approved
